scripts.compile-scxml: scion compile ./src/reducers/drag-and-drop.scxml --format json -o dist/drag-and-drop.json && scion compile ./src/reducers/drag-and-drop.scxml --format module -o dist/drag-and-drop.js
scripts.bundle: cd dist; browserify -d -t babelify ../src/index.js -o ./index.js; sorcery -i index.js
scripts.build: mkdir -p dist; npm run compile-scxml && npm run bundle
scripts.watch: cd dist; watchify -d -t babelify ../src/index.js -o 'cat > index.js; sorcery -i index.js' -v
